stages.text: Find Vex Okonkwo, the outfitter, and buy a laser cannon.

one_way_message.text: First things first - you'll need a weapon to mine with. Vex runs the outfitter's stall just around the ring. A laser cannon's the standard rig; go buy one.

stages.text: Get to your ship and mount the laser in its weapon slot.

one_way_message.text: Good pick. Now mount it - Vex's fitting screen is right there in the stall, so do it before you walk off. Pick the weapon slot and drop the laser in. Your Possessions (2) will show it installed once it's done.

stages.text: Launch, find an asteroid, and shoot it until it breaks - then fly through the ore it leaves behind to collect it.

one_way_message.text: You're armed. Launch and look for asteroids - they drift all through the belt out there. Hold fire on one until it breaks apart, then fly straight through the ore it scatters to scoop it up. Watch for the odd rock with a brighter, warmer color to it - those pay a lot better than the plain gray ones.

stages.text: Land back at the station with your ore.

one_way_message.text: Got a hold full? Head back and land - target the station, autopilot in with F, or fly it in yourself and press G once you're close and slow.

stages.text: Sell your ore to Ilena Cross, the quartermaster.

one_way_message.text: Welcome back. Ilena buys ore just past the outfitter's stall - sell her your hold, and that's the whole loop: mine, dock, sell, repeat. You're a prospector now.
